is raising the price of its bundled channels and flagship Disney+ streaming service to match higher subscription prices of its competitors.
Disney+ Premium without ads will now cost 13% more per month to $21.49, while the channel with ads remains unchanged at $12.99 per month.
A similar ad-free plan offered by Netflix

Disney+ and Hulu bundle without ads will increase by $2 to $21.99, but the ad-supported bundle remains unchanged at $12.99 per month. The price of Disney+ and Hulu separately will cost $0.50 more per month to $12.49 each.
According to sources cited by Bloomberg, subscribers will be notified of the price hikes on Wednesday.
